release_unit: Fresh aggregate tables and anonymized process summaries; individual manuscripts and review text are not included.

math_cohort.fixed_inner_cohort: All 28 written manuscripts from G0-G3 have rounds 0,1,2,3; failed or unwritten episodes are absent from score trajectories.
math_cohort.round_score_precision: Source per-round scores are rounded to two decimals; aggregate sums preserve those recorded values.

historical_assessment.assessor: Three fresh Codex sessions with a SAC simulation rubric in each round
historical_assessment.pass_rule: At least one of three verdicts is Accept
historical_assessment.version_selection: Select the manuscript version with the highest mean score and retain its assessment label
historical_assessment.rounds: Initial scoring plus three refinement and reassessment rounds
historical_assessment.current_round: Version assessed in that round, before best-version retention
historical_assessment.protocol_version: Historical campaign; different from the portable terminal gate

retained_vote_sensitivity.comparison: Selected strategy versus baseline in generation 3
retained_vote_sensitivity.rule: All three retained votes Accept AND each retained score at least 7

strategy_comparison.target_selection: Strategies sought their own research targets; trials are not paired on a preselected theorem
strategy_comparison.generation_0_1: Baseline and selected roles refer to the same batch and must not be summed as separate trials
strategy_comparison.historical_genome: Executed phase prompts and strategy parameters
strategy_comparison.portable_genome_interface: Also exposes worker code, skills, tool procedures and configuration
strategy_comparison.comparison_design: Adaptive historical observation; no matched-target, equal-token/dollar/human-time budget or operator ablation is available.

cost_proxy.refinement_attempts: One reconstructed outer refinement attempt per noninitial scored round
cost_proxy.reviewer_requests: A request comprises three assessor rolls; requests are not added again to the proxy
cost_proxy.whole_population_research_per_pass: 630/15 for the G0-G3 reporting window, retained separately from the selected strategy comparison

rebuttal_evaluator.source: Public OpenReview review histories joined to ProReviewer initial ratings; reported repository aggregates
rebuttal_evaluator.full_57_binary_framing: The source reports raise+same framing on the 57-case source test; it does not specify a separately filtered effective sample denominator.

process_cases.idea: A rescreen of an earlier staged judge-run; the current UCT-guided best-first search is a distinct implementation version.
process_cases.rebuttal: Two historical rounds with three candidate strategies each; legacy proxy stop, not a current-gate re-review or human score outcome.
process_cases.search_interface: Current expansion uses UCT-guided best-first selection; no simulated rollout stage is asserted.

human_time_measurement_plan.status: Prospective protocol, not an observed result
human_time_measurement_plan.design: Matched tasks, consistent quality checking, separate active human-time and machine-cost ledgers

reporting_window.label: G0 initialization plus three evolution generations G1-G3
reporting_window.selection: Retrospective reporting slice chosen for this edition after observing the archive, not a prespecified stopping rule.
reporting_window.scope: Results describe this stage; the underlying archive also contains subsequent generations. Full original records are retained separately.
reporting_window.generation_success_denominator: All research episodes in that generation, including failed and unwritten attempts
reporting_window.strategy_success_denominator: Four research episodes in the selected strategy batch; separate from whole-population success
